summary: Scope fleet standard scans and expose excluded repository inventory

delivery.outcome: Koru standard-fleet scans select primary checkouts in the configured fleet organizations by default and expose excluded local, worktree, duplicate and out-of-scope repositories through a read-only inventory without mutating adopters.
nonGoals: Automatically adopt, commit, push, merge or delete any target repository
Silently include excluded repositories in ticket emission
Change the Wellmanifest standard or adopter pins

architecture.decision: Observe all governed paths in parallel, classify organization/origin/worktree/duplicate scope, expose excluded inventory separately, and pass only selected observations to the existing stale-pin and waiting-input ticket pipeline.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit; the scanner has no adopter-side mutation to undo.

validation.evidence: Governance passed on the exact local HEAD with zero errors and warnings; Ruff passed.
Focused suite: 27 passed. Full deterministic suite: 4163 passed, 19 skipped, 165 deselected, 977 subtests passed.
